release: R06 PASS4 COMPACT AQUA / CARTRIDGE HOST FOUNDATION
work_status: GUI, staged firmware, cartridge host package/stream tests pass under Linux; Windows 11 and physical USB unqualified

passes.name: Windows shell and source workbench
passes.goal: Native Windows 11 GUI, real source editing, safe build/test commands, truthful host status
passes.acceptance: Starts via CMD, source can be edited/saved, build and host tests show real results, no fake connected indicator

passes.name: Linked CPU firmware targets
passes.goal: Boot stages, linker scripts, BSP/HAL and isolated F133/D213 build outputs
passes.acceptance: Reproducible linked ELF and binary, map files, disassembly, size and memory-map checks; not marked bootable until qualified
passes.status: PARTIAL: freestanding dual linked-stage artifacts, board-boot image pending

passes.name: LCD and boot diagnostics
passes.goal: F133 PB3/PB2 I2C driver candidate, simulator event bus, live status codes and power fault indicators
passes.acceptance: Boot-sequence unit tests, bus timeout/recovery tests and independently validated pins/voltages before board
passes.status: PARTIAL: C boot monitor and SerLCD encoder tested; host event/fault simulation added. Actual F133 I2C HAL and live rails/pin qualification pending.

passes.name: Game cartridge and streaming
passes.goal: USB game package, asynchronous streaming scheduler, RAM budgets and latency/fault injection
passes.acceptance: 60 fps deterministic tests with delayed/removed/corrupt drives in host simulation
passes.status: PARTIAL: checksummed host-only .arc1cart + deterministic transfer model; target executable, filesystem host driver, actual USB streaming, removed-cartridge runtime handling not implemented

passes.name: Launcher and graphics pipeline
passes.goal: Branded launcher, framebuffer preview, D213/45F reference queue and game runtime integration
passes.acceptance: One game package loads in host sim, command queues validate, fallback if FPGA unavailable

passes.name: Hardware lab tools
passes.goal: Read-only USB discovery, log capture, FPGA artifact manifest, gated recovery-aware deployment
passes.acceptance: Actual test board discovered and recovered before allowing NOR writes; dry-run, checksum, device confirmation

non_goals: No real NOR writes from this revision
No connected board state without verified actual device
